# Empty State — verify commands on a freshly initialized KB with no pages

# === INIT EMPTY KB ===
exec akb init empty-kb
cd empty-kb

# === LIST RETURNS NO OUTPUT ===
exec akb list
! stdout .

# === SEARCH RETURNS NO OUTPUT ===
exec akb search 'anything'
! stdout .

# === ORPHANS RETURNS NO OUTPUT ===
exec akb orphans
! stdout .

# === RAW LIST RETURNS NO OUTPUT ===
exec akb raw list
! stdout .

# === STATUS SHOWS ZERO PAGES ===
exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 0'

# === LINT SHOWS NO ISSUES ===
exec akb lint
stdout 'No issues found.'

# === LINKS SHOWS ERROR FOR NONEXISTENT PAGE ===
! exec akb links notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# === BACKLINKS SHOWS ERROR FOR NONEXISTENT PAGE ===
! exec akb backlinks notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# === READ SHOWS ERROR FOR NONEXISTENT PAGE ===
! exec akb read notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# === DELETE SHOWS ERROR FOR NONEXISTENT PAGE ===
! exec akb delete notes/nonexistent.md
stderr 'page not found'

# === SEARCH WITH EMPTY QUERY RETURNS ERROR ===
! exec akb search ''
stderr 'search query must not be empty'

# === STATUS ON CLEAN KB ===
exec akb status
stdout 'Git: clean'
